Sustainability

Our equipment moves a tenth of the world's municipal water. Making it more efficient is the largest contribution we can make, and our own operations are held to the same standard.

Commitments

  • Net zero for our own operations by 2040, with an interim 50 percent cut by 2030 against 2020.
  • Every plant water-positive by 2032.
  • An annual sustainability report audited to the same standard as the financial accounts.
